name: Melania
bio: Archetype: ST DPT, Ultimate Cycling, AP-Greedy. ⌽ Ultimate grants [Thief Master]; empowering the next incanation used. ⌽ Ultimate also grants [Fixed Plan], which increases Ultimate Might. ⌽ Skill 1 deals ST mental dmg, reduces enemy moxie at higher ranks and can consume [Thief Master] to steal 1 moxie from the enemy. ⌽ Skill 2 deals mass mental damage with leech rate and can consume [Thief Master] to increase leech rate and gain 1 additional moxie. ⌽ Proccing [Master Thief] allows faster Ultimate cycling and [Fixed Plan] stacking. ⌽ Incredible Ultimate damage at max (6) [Fixed Plan]. Excells at long fights.
